description: This file defines the AdministrationDAO interface, which declares database-related methods for managing global properties and executing SQL, specifically related to the AdministrationService in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: AdministrationDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to the AdministrationService, including retrieving, saving, deleting global properties, executing SQL, and other database configurations.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by its name, may throw DAOException.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Fetches the GlobalProperty object for a given property name.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns a list of all global properties, may throw DAOException.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a GlobalProperty object by its UUID.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Gets all global properties with names starting with the specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Gets all global properties with names ending with the specified suffix.

methods.name: deleteGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a specified global property, may throw DAOException.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Saves or updates a GlobalProperty object, may throw DAOException.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes raw SQL queries; returns a list of results. Throws DAOException.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length allowed for a property of a certain class and field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an object with Spring Errors, may throw DAOException.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Indicates if the database string comparison is case sensitive.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates the PostgreSQL sequence, if applicable.
